notes: R-G2B-02: kid-facing effect text for Orange belt seals #11-15 (Technique Seal format from content/abilities/abilities.json and seals-31-40-text.json). Names and effects come from the S4 table in drafts/planning/S4-self-defense-powers.md; every name is an S4 PROPOSAL and every number there is a guess, so no numbers appear in the text. Each text is one sentence under 80 characters, ages 6-9, hopeful, no pressure. 'Great Counter' is the kid word (S4 still says Perfect Counter). ids are proposed (no #11-15 ids exist in content/abilities yet); the Programmer may adjust at import. effectRef points at the S4 effect and is not final effect JSON. 'flag' marks a line whose wording may change; the R-PROGRESSION-BETA family names may also change any line later.

seals.name: Outside Reap
seals.text: A Great Counter tumbles a brute or swarmer to the ground for a moment.
seals.effectRef: counterThrow 30 ticks (new). Name: S4 'Outside Reap (Osoto Gari)'
seals.flag: Wording follows the Takedown family. Enemy names 'brute' and 'swarmer' are the current content ids; check them if R-G2B-04 renames anything.

seals.name: Reap and Finish
seals.text: Enemies you tumble take extra damage while they are on the ground.

seals.name: Kick the Weapon
seals.text: A Great Counter kicks the weapon aside, so their next hit is weaker.
seals.flag: Says 'weapon' because that is the technique. Until the padded-staff enemy ships, the seal works on every enemy's next attack (S4 fallback).

seals.name: Kick and Spin
seals.text: Your kick lasts longer: their next two hits are weaker.

seals.name: Slip and Double
seals.text: Great Counters add a third quick punch and give you a little more time.
seals.flag: Talks about the Great Counter, not 'Off the Line', because S4 says 'Off the Line adds a 3rd punch' but the Off the Line effect (#1) is not built. Reword once #1 is final.
